ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater/TA450 RMM-agent delivery via phishing (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities)
ucs.description: Hunts execution of legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management agents (Atera, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp) when spawned by an email client, browser, document reader, or archive tool — the signature MuddyWater/TA450 (MERCURY, Static Kitten, Mango Sandstorm) access pattern where spear-phish PDFs/archives link to RMM installers hosted on file-sharing services (e.g. Egnyte) to establish hands-on-keyboard access without custom malware.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","SyncroLive.Agent.Service.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","RSocx.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*AteraAgent*","*ScreenConnect*","*RemoteUtilities*","*Syncro*","*SimpleHelp*")) AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","AcroRd32.exe","Acrobat.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zFM.exe","explorer.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let RMMBinaries = dynamic(["AteraAgent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","SyncroLive.Agent.Service.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","RSocx.exe"]);
let PhishParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","acrord32.exe","acrobat.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","explorer.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName has_any (RMMBinaries)
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","ScreenConnect","RemoteUtilities","Syncro","SimpleHelp","RSocx")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PhishParents)   // RMM launched by a delivery vector, not an admin console
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RMMBinaries = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.service.exe","syncrolive.agent.service.exe","remoteutilities.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","rsocx.exe"]);
let PhishParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","acrord32.exe","acrobat.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","explorer.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildName in (RMMBinaries)
    or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","ScreenConnect","RemoteUtilities","Syncro","SimpleHelp","RSocx")
| where ParentName in (PhishParents)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName,
          TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater/TA450 RMM Agent Spawned by Phishing Delivery Vector
id: 8f1c2a44-3b7e-4e2a-9c1d-7a5e0d3f2b11
status: experimental
description: Detects RMM agents (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp) launched by email/browser/document/archive processes, matching MuddyWater/TA450 RMM-based intrusion tradecraft.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.Service.exe'
      - '\SyncroLive.Agent.Service.exe'
      - '\RemoteUtilities.exe'
      - '\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe'
      - '\RSocx.exe'
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\AcroRd32.exe'
      - '\Acrobat.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  condition: child and parent
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate help-desk RMM rollout where the IT user manually launches the installer from a download folder via Explorer
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1204.001
  - attack.t1204.002
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\AcroRd32.exe OR *\\Acrobat.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe OR *\\explorer.exe) @Image:(*\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\\rutserv.exe OR *\\rfusclient.exe OR *\\Syncro.Service.exe OR *\\RemoteUtilities.exe OR *\\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe OR *\\RSocx.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(outlook|winword|excel|powerpnt|acrord32|acrobat|chrome|msedge|firefox|winrar|7zfm|explorer)\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/(ateraagent|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro\.service|syncrolive\.agent\.service|remoteutilities|simplehelpcustomer|rsocx)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)(ateraagent|screenconnect|remoteutilities|syncro|simplehelp|rsocx)", field=CommandLine))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), min(_time), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])]))
ucs.rationale: MuddyWater/TA450 is distinctive among Iranian state crews for abandoning custom malware in favour of off-the-shelf RMM tooling pushed through spear-phish PDFs/archives linking to file-sharing-hosted installers. Generic RMM-execution rules fire on every IT deployment; pinning the RMM child to a phishing-delivery parent (Outlook/browser/Acrobat/WinRAR) is what isolates this actor's hands-on-keyboard

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater POWERSTATS/PowGoop chain — Office/MSHTA spawning obfuscated PowerShell
ucs.description: Hunts the MuddyWater (Seedworm, TEMP.Zagros) execution chain where a maldoc or HTA launches PowerShell with encoded/obfuscated commands characteristic of the POWERSTATS / PowGoop backdoor (DownloadString, IEX, hidden window, base64/-enc), then beacons over HTTP. Tied to this actor's long-standing reliance on living-off-the-land PowerShell loaders rather than compiled implants.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","outlook.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*-enc*","*-EncodedCommand*","*DownloadString*","*DownloadFile*","*IEX*","*Invoke-Expression*","*-w hidden*","*-WindowStyle Hidden*","*FromBase64String*","*-nop*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","outlook.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","-ec ","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String")
    or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?|ec)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, B64, Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildName in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ParentName in ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","outlook.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","-ec ","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String")
    or TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName,
          ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater POWERSTATS Office/MSHTA to Obfuscated PowerShell Chain
id: 2d9b7c10-6e4f-4a3b-8d12-9f0a1c4e5d22
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell launched by an Office app, MSHTA, or WSH host with obfuscation/download indicators, matching MuddyWater POWERSTATS/PowGoop loaders.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  obfuscation:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
  condition: child and parent and obfuscation
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Office add-ins or admin logon scripts that bootstrap PowerShell
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1027.010
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *FromBase64String* OR *"-w hidden"* OR *"WindowStyle Hidden"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|mshta|wscript|cscript|outlook)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-enc|-encodedcommand|downloadstring|downloadfile|iex|invoke-expression|frombase64string|-w\\s+hidden|windowstyle\\s+hidden|-nop)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=([count(), min(_time), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])]))
